channels.name: Arirang TV
channels.note: Korea's public international broadcaster (English; news, culture, K-culture). arirang.com publishes no terms of use (footer has only a privacy policy). Long-standing Arirang Akamai host; the site player is API-driven so the host could not be matched against it.

channels.name: KTV 국민방송
channels.note: Korean government public-affairs channel on its own .go.kr domain. Copyright policy: only works marked KOGL (Korea Open Government Licence) are free to reuse; the live channel carries no KOGL mark, so third-party-app use is not addressed (contact ktvarchive@korea.kr).

channels.name: سكاي نيوز عربية
channels.note: Abu Dhabi-based; official host. Terms page is behind a captcha and could not be read; the site footer says the Sky trademarks may only be used with prior permission.

channels.name: العربية
channels.note: Dubai-based (MBC Group); official host. Terms page returns 403 to non-browsers and could not be read.

channels.name: العربية Business
channels.note: Business-news sister channel of Al Arabiya; same host and same unreadable terms page.

channels.name: Parliament TV
channels.note: Official House of Representatives feed, delivered by state-owned Kordia. Coverage is widely rebroadcast under the Speaker's rules (no use for political advertising, satire or ridicule), but parliament.nz is bot-protected so the exact wording was not read. Live only when the House sits; otherwise a slate or replays.

events.name: NASA+ Live
events.howTo: NASA TV closed on 2024-08-28; there is no 24/7 NASA channel any more. Each NASA+ live event has its own HLS URL in meta['video-url'] (pattern https://ntv1.akamaized.net/hls/live/2110242/<event>/master.m3u8), airing between meta.first_aired_date and meta.end_aired_date (unix seconds). Show the channel only while an event is live.
events.note: US government work, so public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). NASA media guidelines ask you not to use the NASA logo or imply endorsement. Third-party footage in a broadcast (e.g. SpaceX feeds) may carry its own rights.
